outline.rationale: The user is a total beginner aiming to back a web/app project, so the outline starts from first principles (what a relational DB is) and builds toward practical shipping. Nodes 1-4 establish fundamentals and core SQL (read then write, kept separate to reduce overlap). Node 5-6 target schema design and relationships, which are essential for an app's data model. Node 7 addresses the explicit goal of connecting to application code, including parameterized queries to avoid SQL injection. Node 8 covers indexes and constraints at a "build and run" depth without diving into advanced admin/tuning, which the user chose to deprioritize. Excluded: history, deep internals, replication, clustering, and large-scale backup/performance tuning per the confirmed understanding.
